fig1_order_parameter.svg: Order parameter vs $T/T_c$. The mean-field Ising magnetization (blue, from spontaneous_magnetization) rises continuously below $T_c$ as $\sqrt{3}\,(1-T/T_c)^{1/2}$ (dashed guide, exponent $\beta=\frac{1}{2}$) -- a second-order transition. The exact 1-D chain at $h=0$ (orange, ising_1d_magnetization) is zero at every $T>0$: fluctuations forbid order in one dimension.
fig2_landau_free_energy.svg: Landau free energy $F(m)=a(T-T_c)m^2+b\,m^4$ from landau_free_energy (units $a=b=1$). Above $T_c$ a single well pins $m=0$; at $T_c$ the curvature vanishes; below $T_c$ a symmetric double well appears with minima at $\pm m_0=\pm\sqrt{a(T_c-T)/2b}$ (dots, landau_equilibrium_magnetization) -- spontaneous symmetry breaking, again with $\beta=\frac{1}{2}$.
